title: The classification society survey system taught as operating on a 5-year HSSC framework. HSSC is the IMO statutory harmonised regime; the class cycle is the society's own. RC-01 and RC-02, the D01-S01 critical path.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Lane-B audit D01-S01, RC-01 (CRITICAL) and RC-02 (MATERIAL).
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. A category error in both memorisation-weighted layers of the session's only survey-types card, and the card's own 'Key distinction for exam' bullet already contradicted it. The examiner probe 'is HSSC class or statutory?' is standard for this card's evidenced examiners.
authority: PRIMARY - IMO, Harmonized System of Survey and Certification: HSSC was introduced by the 1988 SOLAS and 1988 Load Line Protocols, and the instrument list names conventions only, never classification society surveys. PRIMARY - IMO Assembly resolution A.1207(34), Survey Guidelines under the HSSC, 2025, adopted 3 December 2025 and revoking A.1186(33), which invites GOVERNMENTS carrying out surveys required by IMO instruments to apply the guidelines - which disposes of the 'IACS HSSC Guidelines' attribution. HELD - DGMA EAC Branch Circular 49 of 2026 Annexure III item 10, quoted verbatim in docs/study/TOPIC_01_STATUTORY_SURVEYS_AND_CLASS.md, which lists the HSSC survey types as STATUTORY. HELD - QP2402 q1, which attributes HSSC to the 1988 Protocols. Class cycle basis: IACS UR Z series (Z3 bottom, Z7 hull, Z18 machinery, Z20 PMS). Bottom survey: two inspections in any five-year period, interval not exceeding 36 months, SOLAS I/10 statutory and IACS UR Z3 class - the clearest case of one survey in both regimes. Intermediate timing per IACS PR1C A.1.3, at or between the second and third annual survey.
